entry.name: showWorkspaces
entry.label: Show the workspace indicator (hidden anyway while there is only one workspace).

entry.name: wheelSwitchesWorkspaces
entry.label: Scrolling over the pill switches workspaces.

entry.name: showDate
entry.label: Show the date before the time.

entry.name: dateFormat
entry.label: Date format: "auto" (weekday, day and month in the order of the region's long date, without the year) or "custom".

entry.name: customDateFormat
entry.label: Date format used when dateFormat is "custom" (QLocale format string).

entry.name: use24hFormat
entry.label: Hour format: 0 = 12-hour, 1 = as the region settings, 2 = 24-hour (same values as the stock digital clock).

entry.name: firstDayOfWeek
entry.label: First day of the week in the calendar: -1 = as the region settings, 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday ... 6 = Saturday.

entry.name: centerInPanel
entry.label: Place the pill on the middle of the panel (within 48 px of where the layout puts the widget), independent of the widths of the widgets beside it.

entry.name: widthBudget
entry.label: Top bar width budget (ADAPTIVE 5.1): when a side of the bar does not fit beside the centred pill, collapse the global menu, the app name, the date, the battery % and the dots, in that order. Off: only tablet posture collapses.

entry.name: menuPolicy
entry.label: When the width budget switches the global menu to its compact view: "centre" (whenever the pill cannot stay on the middle with the full menu, ADAPTIVE 5.1) or "overlap" (only when the bar would otherwise overlap; the pill may leave the middle). Plasma 6.7.5 cannot switch the menu back after it changed, so a compacted menu may stay compact until plasmashell starts again.

entry.name: menuCompacted
entry.label: Internal: the width budget switched the global menu to its compact view (and switches it back). A compact view the user chose is left alone.

entry.name: debugAction
entry.label: Testing only: run one action and clear the key. Values: dump-bar:TAG (logs the top bar's widgets, their x and width in the panel window, the pill's offset from the middle and the budget step).

entry.name: popupGap
entry.label: Gap in px between the top bar and the calendar pop-up.
